title: 第11章 虚影第12章 草甸
content_zh:
黑蛇昂首，面向西山正被余晖浸染的天空，不知熔金流云染红峰峦，亦无多愁善感。
热感应视野里看到山石热量丝丝缕缕散去，感知小虫窸窣活动。
天穹澄澈，短期内无降雨征兆。
简单思索后决定向更远的山岭游去，翻越数道山脊去巡猎，唯有充足的食物才能让身躯生长，蜕变得更长更庞大。
黑蛇脑海里没有离开二字。
生来居无定所，除却冬日蛰伏与吞吐云雾之气，困倦时随便择一处蜷作一团，渴了饮山泉，任日月升落，未来，或许会无声无息死于山林某处吧。
鳞片摩挲光滑的巨岩，准备开启狩猎之旅。
“蛇兄~！”
突然听到熟悉的叫声。
黑蛇看见迟客接近且越来越慢，发冠松散，宽袍沾满草屑泥灰，改成四条腿走路，这模样，倒是比平日两条腿走路顺眼，更像这山中生灵了
迟客胸膛剧烈起伏，将带着食物酸味的喘息散进风里。
“迟某被邪祟附身，还请蛇兄助我……”
迟客攀上平整岩面便瘫软下来，整个人仰面躺倒。
“邪……邪祟！鬼魂……”
他话音未落，视线被硕大阴影笼罩，布满鳞片的蛇头已近在咫尺，分叉信子在眼前快速伸缩颤动，仿佛进行某种无情审视！
黑蛇看见迟客身形轮廓边缘异样，重叠着个扭曲晃动模糊虚影，两者并非一体，倒像将两个截然不同存在强行糅杂在一起，散发出极不协调的别扭，以及阴冷难闻的腐烂气息。
本能有种强烈排斥厌恶感。
蛇遇到异常情况时要么逃跑要么警告或发动攻击，黑蛇弓身蓄力，张嘴露出尖牙嘶鸣警告。
“嘶——！”
嘶声入耳，迟客顿感头皮发麻。那是深植于灵长类血脉最原始的警告，吓得四肢发软冒冷汗。

同样恐惧的不止他一个，附身阴魂意识也不例外。
迟客忽的浑身一轻阴冷消退，昏沉感消失，脑袋清醒许多。
没来得及道谢，黑蛇已猛地弹射出去！
尽管看不见无形鬼物，但迟客知道大黑蛇在追击阴邪，枯叶被碾过的沙沙声极速转几道弯，直至看不见。
其实阴邪不逃的话还不至于被追，可它这一逃，便如野鼠在蛇瞳前窜动，瞬间触动了猎手最原始猎杀本能。
换做寻常蛇类警告恐吓追击一段便作罢，显然现在的黑蛇本质不正常。
因为刚刚见到阴邪时，黑蛇没在意自己为何能看见，更多好奇这玩意与灰暗视角见过的活物有些许相似，但活物散发热量，这模糊影子阴冷，且夹杂刺鼻难闻腐烂味道。
黑蛇从容游弋在阴邪身后，信子轻颤，将独特气息牢牢锁定。
影子每一次加速逃窜，都被不紧不慢拉近距离。
模糊影子移动时无震动可供聆听，热感应视野中也一片空寂，眼睛能看见但远了就看不清，唯剩信子能捕捉腐朽气息。
热感应数次尝试无果，忽然，在灰暗视角调试感知的记忆碎片闪现，于是黑蛇立刻切换感知模式，将热感应聚焦另一特征，非单纯专注普通热量。
果然！那玩意的轮廓在特殊感应下无比清晰！
霎时间，世界在眼中重构。
原本模糊扭曲的阴邪在视野中轮廓毕现，如同墨汁滴入清水，每一个扭曲细节都清晰暴露。
一逃一追，时间流逝。
密林陷入黑暗，偶尔有夜行动物的瞳孔闪着微光。
阴邪速度逐渐迟缓，在黑蛇视野中，它的轮廓随着逃窜出现衰弱，仿佛快速逃窜过程中被不断消耗稀释。
原来影子和飞鸟走兽有相似之处，持续奔跑会消耗会疲惫。
然后，黑蛇纠结是否咬它。
content_en:
The black snake raised its head and faced the sky of the Western Mountain that was being soaked in the afterglow. It didn't know that the molten gold flowing clouds dyed the peaks and mountains red, and it was not sentimental.
In the thermal field of view, he could see the heat of the rocks dissipating, and he could sense the rustling activities of small insects.
The sky is clear and there is no sign of rainfall in the short term.
After a brief thought, he decided to swim to the farther mountains and climb several ridges to hunt. Only with sufficient food can the body grow and become longer and larger.
The word "leave" did not come to Black Snake's mind.
Born to live in no fixed place, except for hibernating in the winter and breathing in the air of clouds and mist, choosing a random place to curl up in a ball when sleepy, drinking from mountain springs when thirsty, and letting the sun and moon rise and set. In the future, I may die silently somewhere in the mountains and forests.
The scales rub against the smooth rock, preparing to start the hunting trip.
"Brother Snake~!"
Suddenly I heard a familiar cry.
Black Snake saw Chi Ke approaching and getting slower and slower. His hair was loose and his robe was stained with grass clippings and mud. He changed to walking on four legs. This appearance was more pleasing to the eye than walking on two legs, and he looked more like this mountain creature.
Chi Ke's chest rose and fell violently, and his breaths carrying the sour smell of food were dispersed into the wind.
"Chi is possessed by an evil spirit, and I asked Brother Snake to help me..."
Chi Ke climbed onto the flat rock surface and then collapsed, lying on his back.
"Evil...evil! Ghost..."
Before he finished speaking, his vision was shrouded by a huge shadow. The scaly snake head was close at hand, and the forked letter was rapidly expanding and contracting in front of his eyes, as if it was undergoing some kind of ruthless inspection!
Black Snake saw that the edges of Chi Ke's figure were strange, overlapping with a twisted, shaking and blurry shadow. The two were not one body, but seemed to be two completely different existences forcibly blended together, exuding an extremely incongruous and awkward smell, as well as a cold and unpleasant smell of decay.
There is a strong instinctive feeling of repulsion and disgust.
When a snake encounters an abnormal situation, it will either run away, warn or attack. The black snake arches its body to gather strength, opens its mouth, reveals its fangs and screams in warning.
"Hiss——!"
The hissing sound reached his ears, and Chi Ke's scalp suddenly felt numb. That was the most primitive warning deeply rooted in the blood of primates. It was so frightened that the limbs went limp and cold sweat broke out.
He is not the only one who is also afraid, and the consciousness of the possessed ghost is no exception.
Chi Ke suddenly felt a slight chill all over his body, his drowsiness disappeared, and his head became much clearer.
Before he could say thank you, the black snake was ejected suddenly!
Although the invisible ghost could not be seen, Chi Ke knew that the big black snake was chasing Yin Xie. The rustling of dead leaves being crushed made it turn several turns at high speed until it was out of sight.
In fact, if Yinxie did not escape, he would not be chased, but his escape was like a wild rat scurrying in front of a snake's eyes, instantly triggering the hunter's most primitive hunting instinct.
If it were an ordinary snake, it would give up after a short period of warning, intimidation and pursuit. Obviously, the current black snake is not normal in nature.
Because when he first saw Yinxie, Black Snake didn't care why he could see it. He was more curious that this thing was slightly similar to the living things he had seen from a dark perspective, but the living things emitted heat, and the blurry shadow was cold and mixed with a pungent and unpleasant smell of decay.
The black snake swam calmly behind Yin Xie, and Xinzi trembled lightly, locking the unique aura firmly.
Every time the shadow sped up to escape, it was slowly getting closer.
There is no vibration to listen to when the blurry shadow moves, and the heat sensor field of vision is also empty. The eyes can see it but cannot see it clearly from a distance. Only Nobuko can capture the decaying atmosphere.
Several attempts at thermal sensing failed. Suddenly, the memory fragments of debugging perception from a dark perspective flashed, so Black Snake immediately switched to the sensing mode and focused the thermal sensing on another feature instead of just focusing on ordinary heat.
really! The outline of that thing is extremely clear under the special induction!
In an instant, the world was reconstructed in front of my eyes.
The outlines of the originally blurry and twisted Yinxie appeared in the field of vision, like ink dripping into clear water, and every twisted detail was clearly exposed.
Escape and chase, time passes.
The dense forest fell into darkness, and occasionally the pupils of nocturnal animals shimmered.
Yinxie's speed gradually slowed down, and in the black snake's field of vision, its outline appeared as it fled.Weak, as if being diluted by constant consumption in the process of rapid escape.
It turns out that shadows are similar to birds and animals. Continuous running will consume and tire you out.
Then, the black snake debated whether to bite it.
